verdicts.reason: A: the 'RSVP Free' CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill the same size as the badges, so it is buried. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the tagline, which breaks the reading order. 'Saturday 21 June' crowds the headline's lower-left edge, the legal line is illegible, and the phone is cropped at the right edge. B: the headline and logo block on the left are strong, but the right half is scattered. The tagline, location, badges and a tiny RSVP pill float around as fragments, and the partner-logo placeholder is blown up into a huge grey box. Its legal text is also unreadable. A is less bad because it holds together as one centred composition.
